scope: Add an offline, target-separated Tardis Kraken L2 execution-risk research pipeline. It does not import or modify the live trader, canonical close-price policy, exit optimiser, model bundles, admission map, or exchange execution configuration.

implementation.raw_data: Manifest is exact-map plus official Tardis metadata, first UTC day of each month only. Downloader is resumable and atomic; raw files are immutable after checksum validation.
implementation.reconstruction: L2 snapshots reset state; zero quantity deletes a level; nonzero quantity replaces a level; same-local-timestamp messages are atomic; pre-snapshot and invalid books never form state features.
implementation.spot_futures_boundary: Book walker accepts Kraken Spot base quantities and quote notionals only. Futures integration needs a separately validated adapter.
implementation.surface: Causal minute/message state features are separate from future-only deterioration labels. No forward fill across missing or crossed books.
implementation.oracle: Uses the existing policy exit timestamp and a predeclared earlier-exit set only. The parent close policy is never optimised or altered.
implementation.models: Only date-level chronological controls: empirical shrinkage, OHLCV-only shallow LGBM, and L2-aware shallow LGBM. No random row split or broad HPO.

commands: synthetic exact-mapping and train-bin sanity check

results.raw_tardis_download: not run: no explicit exact mapping or pre-existing Tardis raw data was present; this is an offline research pipeline and the live stack was not touched
